description:
Build simple activity charts and other time-series views across supported VMs, including compare-previous windows and grouped EVM contract trends.

COMMON USER ASKS:
- Base transactions per 5m bucket
- Compare two periods

FIRST CHOICE FOR:
- activity over time, compare-current-vs-previous, grouped trends, and simple activity charts

WHEN TO USE:
- You want chart-ready metric buckets over time.
- You want a simple activity chart. Use a shorter window on fast networks such as Base.
- You want to compare the current period to the previous period.

DON'T USE:
- You need raw record lists instead of aggregated buckets.
- You need DEX pool candles or OHLC output.

EXAMPLES:
- Base transactions per 5m bucket: {"network":"base-mainnet","metric":"transaction_count","duration":"15m","interval":"5m"}
- Compare two periods: {"network":"solana-mainnet","metric":"transaction_count","duration":"1h","interval":"5m","compare_previous":true}

address.description: Optional: Filter to specific contract address for contract-specific trends

compare_previous.description: Compare the selected window against the immediately previous window

duration.description: Total time period to analyze. Defaults to "15m" on Base mainnet and Sepolia, and "6h" elsewhere. This tool reads every block and refuses windows over 12,000 blocks. Accepts compact durations like "30m" or natural phrases like "past 30 minutes".

from_timestamp.description: Starting timestamp. Accepts Unix seconds, Unix milliseconds, ISO datetime, or relative input like "24h ago".

group_by.description: Optional grouping mode. contract is currently supported only for EVM transaction_count

group_limit.description: Maximum number of contract groups when group_by=contract

metric.description: Metric to aggregate over time. Per chain family: evm: transaction_count, transactions_per_block, avg_gas_price, gas_used, block_utilization, unique_addresses; solana: transaction_count, unique_addresses, tps, avg_fee, success_rate, slots_per_hour; bitcoin: transaction_count, unique_addresses, fees_btc, block_size_bytes; hyperliquid: volume, fill_count, unique_traders. Others are refused.

mode.description: Execution depth. Defaults to complete requested-window analysis; the optional fast value is only for explicitly bounded previews.

to_timestamp.description: Ending timestamp. Accepts Unix seconds, Unix milliseconds, ISO datetime, or relative input like "now".
